title: This week's hottest physics papers on arXiv

sections.title: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene
sections.abstract: The authors report gate-tunable Chern insulators and an incipient superconducting regime in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene, with topology controlled by twist angle and doping.
sections.claimed_result: Displacement-field-controlled incipient superconductivity with tunable Chern insulating states.
sections.caveat: Resistance does not reach zero; the abstract characterizes the result as incipient superconductivity.

sections.title: 100 million photons per second from a single organic molecule
sections.abstract: A cryogenic metallo-dielectric antenna directs emission from one organic molecule with 97% collection efficiency, 91.2% indistinguishability, and 97.7% single-photon purity.
sections.claimed_result: 100 million photons per second into the first lens from a single dibenzoterrylene molecule.
sections.caveat: The performance is demonstrated under cryogenic operation in a specific emitter–antenna architecture.

sections.title: Syndrome measurements enable deterministic fault-tolerant T gates
sections.abstract: The authors propose a syndrome-mediated mechanism for deterministic logical T gates in stabilizer codes and give fault-tolerant constructions.
sections.claimed_result: A syndrome measurement and feed-forward mechanism implements a deterministic logical T gate for stabilizer codes in a suitable basis.
sections.caveat: Protection claims use specified circuit and noise assumptions; hardware validation remains open.

sections.title: Observation of universal hierarchical relaxation in a quantum simulator
sections.abstract: A trapped-ion quantum simulator experimentally demonstrates a predicted hierarchy of autocorrelation relaxation exponents in the diffusive regime.
sections.claimed_result: Observation of universal hierarchical relaxation with a theory extension for multiple conservation laws.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports the diffusive regime; universality elsewhere remains to be tested.

sections.title: Multi-messenger and multi-band signal from first-order phase transitions in proto-neutron stars
sections.abstract: Proto-neutron-star calculations predict linked kHz and MHz gravitational-wave emission plus a delayed neutrino burst during a first-order phase transition.
sections.claimed_result: Correlated gravitational-wave and neutrino signals could constrain the phase transition and nuclear matter.
sections.caveat: The signals are predictions and depend on phase-transition models and detector sensitivity.

sections.title: Fully passive monolithic silicon quantum photonic circuit for entangled photon-pair generation
sections.abstract: A fully integrated silicon photon-pair source operates without active tuning and reports high coincidence and interference performance.
sections.claimed_result: High-performance entangled-photon generation in a passive silicon circuit tolerant of fabrication variation.
sections.caveat: System-scale integration, long-term stability, and fabrication yield are not established in the abstract.

sections.title: Equation of state and transport coefficients of warm dense aluminum from mixed deterministic-stochastic density functional theory
sections.abstract: Mixed deterministic-stochastic finite-temperature DFT predicts substantial departures from common models for warm dense aluminum.
sections.claimed_result: Improved equation-of-state and transport data up to 1000 eV with large deviations from model-based approaches.
sections.caveat: Validation against high-energy-density experiments and model assumptions remains necessary.

sections.title: Two-rung ladder: H0 from Tip of the Red Giant Branch and geometric anchors alone
sections.abstract: A TRGB distance ladder gives H0 values whose uncertainty is dominated by local peculiar-velocity and density-field variance.
sections.claimed_result: The ladder cannot yet arbitrate the Hubble tension because local-structure uncertainty dominates.
sections.caveat: One reconstruction dominates the evidence-weighted estimate and the sample is mostly local.
